comment: Communities/districts along the full Airport→Kingston→Bog Walk→Fern Gully→Ocho Rios route. Each entry triggers a community sign (recognition layer 2). Entries marked needs_owner_review need the owner's lived knowledge to confirm position and spelling — map data alone is insufficient. Radius is in compressed-world units (1 world unit ≈ 3.33 m real).

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The narrow strip of land connecting the airport to Kingston — sea on both sides, iconic coconut trees lining the road.

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Major roundabout at the foot of the Blue Mountains — gateway from the Palisadoes into the city.

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: East Kingston hillside community — owner to confirm whether it's visible/named from Windward Road at this point.

communities.name: East Kingston
communities.note: Entry into Kingston proper along Windward Road.

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Historic Kingston crossroads — major commercial intersection at the heart of the city.

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: The commercial heart of uptown Kingston — named for the cotton tree that once stood here.

communities.name: Twickenham Park
communities.note: Residential community on the approach to Spanish Town.

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Jamaica's old colonial capital — once the most important city on the island. Route passes via bypass; owner to confirm sign placement.

communities.name: Angels
communities.note: Community at the entrance to the Bog Walk Gorge — owner to confirm name spelling and exact position.

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Town at the heart of the Flat Bridge gorge — the Rio Cobre roars below. Named for the Bogle Walk or the boggy terrain, accounts differ.

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Famous for its market — the Linstead Market folk song was born here. 'Carry mi ackee go a Linstead market…'

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Alumina plant town. Owner to confirm whether the route passes through Ewarton or bypasses it on the way to Moneague.

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Highland crossroads town in St. Ann — Moneague College here, cool air after the climb from Linstead.

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Famous roadside cookshop strip — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival, roast corn. A mandatory stop.

communities.name: Claremont
communities.note: Agricultural community in St. Ann on the descent toward Fern Gully. Owner to confirm it is on this route.

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: 800+ species of ferns line this famous tree-covered gorge road — a natural cathedral. Bamboo canopy overhead.

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: The tourist capital of Jamaica's north coast — Dunn's River Falls and journey's end.
